latest_release.name: v0.3.0 — Street Level, On Your Phone, in Your Language
latest_release.body: v0.3.0 brings God's Eye View down to the street, into your pocket and into three new languages. Open street-level photos from four providers without leaving the globe, use the app on a phone with a layout built for it, and read the interface in Spanish, Russian or Simplified Chinese. Short share links, a rebuilt voice assistant, your own map files, GNSS interference and aircraft emergencies, ten new camera packs and about thirty new bikeshare systems come with it. ## Street Level See the street from the globe (Cameras ▸ Street Level). Coverage lines drape on the terrain and Google 3D tiles; click a street and the nearest photo opens in the panel, flat or 360°, with view cones along its sequence and ‹ › to step through it. - **Four providers, one at a time**: **Panoramax** and **KartaView**, which need no key at all, **Mapillary** with a free client token, and **Google Street View** on the Google 3D map with your Google Maps key. - Every caption names the photo's author and licence and links to the original. - Filter by 360° or flat imagery and by capture date; share links remember the provider and filters. - Host apps can compose their own provider list, and point Mapillary at a server-side Graph endpoint so no token reaches the page. ## On your phone On screens 720 px wide and narrower, the globe stays full screen and a bottom tab bar (Layers, Cameras, Context, Search, More) opens one panel sheet at a time. Swipe a sheet down to close it. - Pinch zoom is three times as responsive, aircraft and ships are easier to tap, and opening Context shows the aircraft you are tracking. - Add it to your home screen: the app ships a web app manifest and icons, so it installs with the God's Eye View mark instead of a blank tile. ## In your language The interface now speaks **Spanish**, **Russian** and **Simplified Chinese**. Pick a language from the globe button in the bottom-right corner, or open the app with `?lang=es`, `?lang=ru` or `?lang=zh-CN`; by default it follows your browser. - Each language is one JSON file keyed by the English text, and `npm test` fails on missing or broken translations, so adding a language is a contained piece of work. ## Also in this release ### Short share links - The share button makes short `/share/` links. The code is a compact, versioned description of the view, so a link opens the same way on any copy of the app, including your own local install. - A link can follow an aircraft, military aircraft or satellite. If it has stopped reporting, the view opens at its last known position and says so. - A mistyped link is refused instead of opening the wrong view, and older long `#v=2` links keep working. - The codec is a package export, so a server can read share links, for example for link previews ([format](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/blob/main/docs/SHARE-LINK-FORMAT.md)). ### Voice - **Answers you can trust.** Voice can turn on and query every data layer by its everyday name ("buses", "hurricanes", "military bases"). # 🌐 God's Eye View [![CI](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Reached #1 on GitHub Trending](https://img.shields.io/badge/%231_GitHub_Trending-thank_you!-F0A63C?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://x.com/bilawalsidhu/status/2093798887815348521) ### A spy-satellite simulator in your browser — then you realize the sources are public and the data is real. Photorealistic 3D globe. Live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras. Hands-free voice control powered by a realtime AI agent. _No place left behind._ ![Orbital HUD, a tracked live globe, FLIR terrain — then OPEN SOURCED](docs/media/hero-open-source-reveal.gif) ▶️ **From the project behind the viral God's Eye View series** _(formerly WorldView)_ — [5M+ on YouTube](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6qSg2I-7_koPbDnSMo0QeeHX_RknA2uv&si=nBGYMoHWQw41v93Q) · [25M+ across socials](https://www.google.com/search?q=god%27s+eye+view) 🏆 **Reached #1 on GitHub Trending, daily and weekly · August 2026** **[#8 Product of the Day](https://www.producthunt.com/products/god-s-eye-view?launch=god-s-eye-view)** · Hunted by Chris Messina, creator of the hashtag _“pretty cool”_ — [Brendan Eich](https://x.com/BrendanEich/status/2094592096401490266), creator of JavaScript and co-founder of Mozilla and Brave · Featured on **[Pinokio](https://pinokio.co/posts/01m1m4p9xxm3qw7dnnpj2wr93g)** ⚡ **Start without API keys.** Install with [Pinokio](https://pinokio.co/apps/github-com-bilawalsidhu-gods-eye-view) or run locally from the terminal. Add optional keys inside the app. **[→ Quick Start](#-quick-start)**
---
**[Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [First Five Minutes](#-the-first-five-minutes) · [Talk to It](#-talk-to-it) · [What's Live](#-whats-on-the-globe) · [Under the Hood](#-under-the-hood) · [Keys & Costs](#-api-keys) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)**
--- ## 🌍 Why This Exists God's Eye View brings public signals into one explorable globe. Track the world live. Talk to it. Break it. Extend it. Flight transponders, ship beacons, orbital elements, seismographs, and public cameras already tell us a lot about the world. God's Eye View puts them in the same place, so you can move between a global picture and an individual aircraft, ship, or street. It runs locally in your browser, with source code you can inspect and extend. > Half the magic is that it looks like a forbidden cockpit. The other half is that every line of code is inspectable. Most feeds are live or regularly refreshed. Traffic is simulated along real roads using aggregate location data. CCTV camera poses and rocket launch trajectories are coarse estimates.
